triggers.name: Generate Video Script
triggers.description: Generate a YouTube video script given a topic
triggers.prompt: Generate a detailed YouTube video script for the topic provided. Include intro hook, main sections with timestamps, call-to-action, and outro. Save the output to scripts/output/<slug>.md.

triggers.name: Create Video Metadata
triggers.description: Generate SEO-optimised title, description, and tags for a video
triggers.prompt: Create YouTube SEO metadata (title under 70 chars, description under 5000 chars with keywords, 15 tags) for the video described. Save to scripts/output/<slug>_metadata.json.

triggers.name: Analyse Channel Performance
triggers.description: Review recent video metrics and suggest improvements
triggers.prompt: Using the YouTube Data API, fetch the last 10 video stats from config/channel.json, identify trends, and write a report to logs/analysis_<date>.md.

triggers.name: Bulk Update Descriptions
triggers.description: Append a standard footer/CTA to all video descriptions
triggers.prompt: Read the footer template from config/channel.json and append it to the descriptions of all videos that don't already contain it. Log every updated video ID to logs/bulk_update_<date>.log.
